register.labelZh: HOLD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hold on、hold back、hold down、hold off 和 hold up 等表達,可以幫助你描述抓緊、阻止、按住、抵擋和舉起事物。；hold out 可以表示食物、金錢或體力仍能維持;hold up 則可以表示生意、道路或物件在困難下仍保持良好狀態。；你可以用 hold somebody to 表示要求某人履行承諾、用 hold to 表示堅守原則、用 holdsomething against somebody 表示怪責某人,以及用 hold with 表示贊成某種做法。；hold out for 表示某人等待更好的選擇;hold out on 和 hold something over somebody 則可以描述人與人之間的隱瞞和施壓。
register.summaryEn: Expressions such as hold on, hold back, hold down, hold off and hold up help you describe gripping, stopping, restraining, protecting and raising things. Hold out can show that food, money or strength continues to last. Hold up can show that a business, road or object remains in good condition. You can hold somebody to a promise, hold to your principles, refuse to hold a mistake against somebody, or say that you do not hold with a particular action. Hold out for shows that someone is waiting for a better choice. Hold out on and hold something over somebody describe hidden information and pressure between people.
contextsZh: 使用 HOLD 描述實際控制和保護
描述事物能否繼續或維持良好狀態
清楚談論承諾、原則和個人態度
描述壓力、選擇和隱瞞資料
contextsEn: Use HOLD to describe physical control and protection
Describe whether something continues or remains strong
Talk clearly about promises, principles and personal feelings
Describe pressure, choices and hidden information
